additional_native_contract_cases.name: native-active-limit-success
additional_native_contract_cases.source: prewritten Coax active-projection check; independent expected trajectory not yet computed

standalone_step_reason: All nonzero-initial-error contexts, plus active-limit success. Declared zero-update home/endpoint solves stay zero-update; no post-convergence motion is invented.
algorithm: Independent homogeneous 4x4 product-rule tangents; solve (J J^T + lambda^2 I)y = target-position using partial-pivoted Gaussian3 (not inverse); delta=J^T y; one global infinity-norm scale; coordinate-wise source interval projection; fixed stopping/budget.
floating_order: math.fsum for dot products, ordinary F64 lambda*lambda, scalar math.sin/cos/sqrt; explicit source one-radian coefficient basis

kinds.3: trace terminal zero-budget Coax convergence query

count_semantics: Per-step updates=1 and projection=count of coordinates strictly outside source limits before clipping; full solve counters sum updates and projections; terminal zero-budget query counters=0. Status non-ok leaves exact finite poison104B unchanged.
trajectory_control: C asks pik_solve(current,target,0) for convergence and then calls pik_step. It does not implement product DLS or stopping arithmetic. Independent Python trajectory supplies the separate expected values.
